hero.title: Study Physiotherapy in USA for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Study physiotherapy in the USA for Indian students — explore the Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree, top CAPTE-accredited US universities, eligibility, admission process, costs, and NPTE licensing pathways.

faq.question: What degree is required to practice physiotherapy in the USA?
faq.answer: To practice as a licensed physical therapist in the United States, students must complete a CAPTE-accredited Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree and pass the National Physical Therapy Examination (NPTE).

faq.question: Can Indian BPT graduates study Physiotherapy in the USA?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) graduates can apply for post-professional MS/PhD programmes in rehabilitation sciences, transitional DPT tracks, or credential evaluation through FCCPT for NPTE eligibility.

faq.question: How long is a DPT program in the USA?
faq.answer: A Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) program typically takes 3 years of full-time study following a qualifying undergraduate degree with science prerequisites.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying Physiotherapy in the USA?
faq.answer: Tuition for DPT and MS programmes in the USA generally ranges from USD 30,000 to USD 65,000 per year depending on whether the university is public or private, plus living expenses.

faq.question: Is GRE required for Physiotherapy in the USA?
faq.answer: Many US DPT programmes require GRE scores alongside PTCAS applications, prerequisite science coursework, and observation hours, though requirements vary by university.
